panels.description: Number of currently observed containers for each Compose service. Replicas appear as separate containers and are counted under their service.
panels.title: Running containers by Compose service

panels.description: Filesystem capacity percentage for block devices visible inside Docker Desktop's Linux VM. This is not Windows host disk usage or per-container volume usage.
panels.title: Docker VM disk usage by device

panels.description: Filesystem read and write throughput for each container. cAdvisor on this Docker Desktop host does not provide a reliable per-container bind-mount capacity breakdown.
panels.title: Filesystem I/O by container

options.content: **Scope:** cAdvisor reports Linux container CPU, memory, network, and filesystem I/O. Filesystem panels show read/write throughput, not storage capacity. cAdvisor does not provide a dependable per-container breakdown of host bind-mounted data directories here. On Docker Desktop for Windows, these are metrics for containers in Docker Desktop's Linux VM, not total Windows host usage. cAdvisor needs privileged host visibility. Compose service labels group replicas while each container remains a separate series.
